summary: IsoEnergy Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing the closing of a transaction with DISA Technologies to form DISA Uranium Corporation. IsoEnergy contributed its Utah uranium mine portfolio in exchange for 1,677,350 shares, representing approximately 33% ownership on a fully diluted basis, plus a US$33 million investment in DISA Uranium's concurrent US$105 million private placement. The new company combines IsoEnergy's assets with DISA's HPSA technology. DISA Uranium's board includes IsoEnergy and Tembo Capital representatives. Watch for IsoEnergy's ongoing equity stake value and DISA Uranium's strategic development of the Tony M Mine.
